protein_summary.reference_state: Ras has no nucleotide-free apo form. For this entry the reference state (is_wt_apo true) is WT K-Ras4B 1-169 loaded with nucleotide (GDP or GTP; GMPPNP rows are marked as analogue) with Mg2+ bound and no protein partner, inhibitor or fragment. binding_state names the nucleotide (bound:GDP·Mg, bound:GTP·Mg, bound:GMPPNP·Mg); Mg2+-free, partner-bound and C118S-background samples are not the reference.

per_window.ps-ns: dynamic_in_window in both nucleotide states (NASR, 298 K, HEPES): GTP·Mg WT has mobile termini and C-terminal loops, a moderately mobile Switch II and a restrained Switch I (KRAS-J9, r4); GDP·Mg WT has large Switch I (E31, Y32) and Switch II (G60-S65) motions placed at 10 ns to 1 us (KRAS-J10, r7). Mg2+-free G12C-GDP makes D30-Y40 ps-flexible (KRAS-J19, r25). Not judged: mutant NASR rows r5, r6, r8, r9 (WT-like except G60 and A59).
per_window.us-ms: GTP·Mg WT: dynamic_in_window, one global process near 400 s-1 with 8-10% state 1 at 25 °C in two HEPES laboratories and in PBS/EDTA (KRAS-J1 r1, J2 r26, J3 r17 r118); GMPPNP·Mg WT shows a synchronized effector-lobe methyl cluster (KRAS-J8, r84). GDP·Mg WT: no millisecond minor state in HEPES without EDTA (KRAS-J6, r10); methyl CPMG flat but faster effector-lobe exchange by adiabatic dispersion (KRAS-J7, r83); the 2.8-3.8% Mg2+-free-like state seen only in PBS with 10 mM EDTA is artefact_suspected (KRAS-J4 r13, J5 r21). Mutants follow the same pattern (KRAS-J14-J18, J20-J23). RBD-bound GTP·Mg exchange is quenched (KRAS-J12); GDP·Mg + RBD exchange is binding kinetics, not counted (KRAS-J13).
per_window.slower_than_ms: not_measured for the reference state (KRAS-J11): time-resolved structural and EPR/DEER searched with no hits. Not judged: smFRET of membrane-anchored, dye-labelled full-length G12V in nanodiscs (r34; 10 ms bins, no rate stated).
per_window.undetermined: 31P of C118S-background K-Ras at 278 K: about 90% or more state 2 with native GTP, much more state 1 with GppNHp (KRAS-J25, r38 r44); G12D HDX deprotection, unresolved (KRAS-J24, r29); MD of WT GDP·Mg, GTP·Mg and Mg2+-free GDP (KRAS-J26 r51 r52 r53 r60 r67, J27 r119); multi-temperature WT-GDP crystals, preprint (KRAS-J28, r89). Not judged: mutant 31P rows r39-r43, r45-r50 (C118S background, inhibitor r50); mutant and other-construct MD r54-r59, r61-r66, r68-r73, r99-r105, r120-r122; crystal and other-construct structures r35-r37, r74-r82, r97, r98, r111, xiang2026-r12; ligand- or partner-bound WT structures r78, r79; G13D RDC ensemble r33; membrane PRE r88; abstract-only rows r106-r110; G12C multi-temperature crystals r90; B-Raf RBD-observed rows xiang2026-r5, r7 (partner observed, appendix-only); G12D+RBD rows xiang2026-r3, r11; H-Ras and other homolog rows r91-r96, r112-r117 (homolog only).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: GTP·Mg: yes, free WT K-Ras with native GTP exchanges at 25 °C between a dominant state 2 and a GDP-like state 1 across Switch I, Switch II and the P-loop with kex about 400 s-1 and 8-10% state 1 (400 ± 12 s-1, p1 10.15 ± 0.47% and 414 ± 3 s-1, 9.6 ± 0.1% in HEPES; 404 ± 54 s-1, pE 7.8 ± 0.2% in PBS/EDTA). GDP·Mg: no millisecond minor state is seen at 298 K in HEPES without EDTA, the switches instead move on 10 ns-1 us scales with faster-than-CPMG effector-lobe exchange in methyl data, and the 2.8-3.8% Mg2+-free-like state (kex 164 ± 28 s-1 CPMG, 267 ± 20 s-1 CEST) reported in PBS with 10 mM EDTA is a suspected EDTA vs Mg artefact.
open_conflicts: CPMG versus CEST on the same PBS/EDTA GDP samples: kex 164 vs 267 s-1 (WT), 99 vs 214 (G12C), 345 vs 668 (G12D), 172 vs 492 (G12V); the authors call them in fair agreement and read one dominant process, but the rates differ by up to about threefold (r13-r16, r21-r24).

GTP-state exchange model: amide data are fitted as one global two-state process (r1, r17, r26), while GMPPNP methyl data show a synchronized effector-lobe cluster plus allosteric methyls with non-uniform temperature dependence (r84), and state-1 mutants T35S and V29G retain extra or faster processes (r28, r86, r87); whether free WT has more than one process is not settled by these rows.
questions_for_gina: The RelaxDB KRAS_CPMG labels match the Hansen 2023 WT K-Ras·GTP·Mg sample (20 mM HEPES pH 7.0, 298 K, 600/850 MHz): the seven unlabelled non-proline residues ('.' at Y64; N at Y32, I55, S65, M72, T87, N116) are exactly the seven non-proline residues without a per-residue Δϖ in that paper's WT GTP source data, and all 45 residues with |Δϖ| > 0.5 ppm are labelled exchange (145 of 158 residues agree at 0.5 ppm, 154 of 158 at 0.4 ppm). The GDP samples fit worse (Pálfy 2022 GDP CPMG fit set: 119 of 158 agree; Hansen 2023 GDP shows no millisecond exchange and is fully assigned), and the Pálfy 2022 GTP sample lacks Switch II assignments that the labels carry. Can you confirm the labels come from Hansen 2023 WT GTP, and should GTP·Mg then be the headline reference state?

We mark the Palfy 2022 GDP minor state (Mg2+-free-like shifts, PBS with 10 mM EDTA) as a suspected EDTA vs Mg artefact because HEPES samples without EDTA show no millisecond state for GDP; do you agree, or do you know of a measurement that shows it in Mg2+-saturated K-Ras-GDP?
protein_summary.buffer_note: All Palfy 2022 NMR samples (r13-r25, r118) used PBS pH 7.4 with 10 mM EDTA and 15 mM MgCl2 (5 mM nominal Mg2+ excess; free Mg2+ not measured) and no EDTA-free or phosphate-free control. Hansen 2023 (r1-r12), Rennella (r26-r28), the methyl studies (r30-r32, r83-r87), the 31P study (r38-r50) and Xiang 2026 used HEPES without phosphate or EDTA in the final sample. The GTP exchange agrees across buffers (404 ± 54 vs 400 ± 12 and 414 ± 3 s-1); only the GDP minor state depends on the PBS/EDTA buffer, and its Mg2+-free-like shifts make incomplete Mg2+ occupancy the suspected cause (inference, untested by any source).
